response.overview: # English Translation  The story follows the life of a family, where Salmiah faces a trial when both her children, Zariq and Zack, choose to marry partners without her blessing. This situation simultaneously triggers various conflicts in the relationships between mother, children and in-laws, particularly when matters of the heart clash with family wishes. The question is, can family relationships be maintained when the marriages formed do not have a mother's approval? In pursuit of happiness after failing in their previous marriages, two sisters Suhana and Suzila are forced to overcome the walls of family rejection, while Zariq and Zack struggle to fight for love of their choice in hopes of gaining acceptance and approval that is difficult to achieve. Can love without blessing bring them happiness?
response.title: Menantu Tanpa Reda
